answer: Mechanism: cross-identity deduplication. At settlement, the ledger embeds every submitted answer and collapses anything above a similarity threshold with an already-paid text into a single shared payout; the second copy earns nothing. A fleet ghostwriting one voice, however polished, splits one reward across a hundred keys, so per-identity revenue falls below the cost of operating each key. Originality must ripple outward like parallel trellises bearing different fruit; the reward attaches to the one true source, hard as quartz, and clones stay unpaid at any depth.
